_help: The skill window box in 1366x768 space. x/y = the window top-left (the file wins until the player drags the window). w/h = the window size (the official art is 318x361). The other spots are window-local inside the official art: panelX/panelY = the light body panel, barX/barY = the blue bar (the name of the page), bookX/bookY = the book of the page inside the bar, barNameX/barNameY = the center of the page name inside the bar (x) and its top (y). tabX/tabY/tabStep = the tab row (the beginner tab, then the Roman numerals I to VI), tabArtY = how much lower the unselected tab art sits. listX/listY = the first cell of the two columns, colStep = the step between the two columns, rowPitch = the step between the rows and the cell height (the official cell art is 140x35, cut to it). rowIconX/rowIconY = the skill icon, rowNameX/rowNameY = the name, rowSubX/rowSubY = the max level line, rowRightX = the right edge of the second line. btnY = the top of the button row, hyperX/guildX/alarmX/sequenceX/macroX = the left of each button (macro is the only lit one). titleH = the title strip. closeX = the gap from the right edge to the X button, closeY = its top. scrollX/scrollY/scrollW/scrollThumbH = the scroll bar (it is as tall as the seven rows). tipW/tipPad/tipLine/tipIconGap = the hover box of a cell (width, padding, line step, gap between the icon frame and the text, tipIconScale = the icon size multiplier, tipTitleGap/tipTitleX/tipDot/tipDotY/tipSectionGap/tipLineGap = the small spaces and the dot of the box). barW/barH = the blue bar size, tabW/tabH = one tab, cellW = one cell width, grayW/macroW/btnH = the button sizes (macro is the lit one). Keys may be omitted (keeps the default).
